basic_profile.bio: I'm a 41-year-old fermentation enthusiast hailing from Portland, Oregon. I fell in love with the art of fermentation after a trip to South Korea, where I was introduced to the world of kimchi and other traditional ferments. By day, I work as a software developer, but my true passion lies in experimenting with different types of fermentation in my spare time. I'm happily married and enjoy spending weekends hiking in the beautiful Pacific Northwest. My online hours are typically in the evening, after a long day of coding. My dislikes include overly processed foods and unnecessary waste. I'm an advocate for sustainable living.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which explains my tech-savvy side, but my true expertise in fermentation comes from years of self-teaching and practice. I've read extensively on the subject, attended workshops, and am part of a local fermentation club that meets monthly.
